builds.goal: Explore a large one awakened Q attack with isolated lightning number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Awakened Q has an AP-scaled magic lightning component even though ordinary Q rewards AD and HP. The source lists six strikes per empowered attack and 0.00006 AP of target maximum HP per strike; isolation controls whether all strikes stay on one target. Ordinary delivery and awakened physical max-HP damage must be measured separately. Deathcap, magic penetration and conditional Shadowflame target the lightning rather than turning Q into a spell that can ordinarily crit.
